question: How do seed initialization, fixed cursor-row production and world restart reconstruct state?

prng.selection: VHPOSR WORD bits 2..3 select LONG offsets 0,4,8,12.
prng.writes: The LONG store at $7EA and WORD store at $7E8 write six bytes; old WORD $7EE..$7EF survives into the second state LONG. Seed entry falls through one complete advance.
prng.recurrence: Repeat 32 times: feedback = (shift bit 3 XOR history bit 0); history.B = outgoing shift bit 31 ? FF : 00; shift = (shift<<1)|feedback. Preserve history high 24 bits and return the second LONG in D0/D1.
prng.registers: Normal return changes D0,D1,A0 and CCR; D2-D7,A1-A6 retain identity, A7 balances under a disjoint valid stack.
prng.limits: No period, entropy, distribution or gameplay-reachability claim. This is absolute low RAM, distinct from A6-relative grid-cell aliases.

restart.object_writes: Restore initial flags, selected item, item state, HP and script; recompute the name from the current item-definition byte and zero script delay. Two banks copy eight BYTEs forward, with ordinary sequential overlap effects.
restart.seed_lifecycle: The complete world reset does not reseed or modify the absolute eight-byte PRNG state. Runtime tilemap initialization calls the seed entry separately.
restart.limits: Full reset witness uses valid original records and current flags matching their initial inactive parity. Existing exchange/conditional-receptacle tests cover those separate branches; arbitrary replacement graphs, aliases and lifetime remain open.
restart.coordinates: All 35 table-record coordinates are perturbed in the full-reset witness. NPC object XY remain as stored; player XY reset to (241,866). This routine resets script cursors, but later script execution is a separate operation.

cursor_rows.behavior: Copy first two WORDs to plane 0 rows and next two to plane 1 rows, then skip eight input bytes. Both preceding control LONGs remain unchanged.
cursor_rows.limits: CPU writes in flat RAM only. No file-backed allocation, chipset DMA completion or complete alias/writer proof.

reused_checks.reason: No framework, CPU or reference-rendering implementation changes in this batch. Prior state-exchange and conditional-receptacle witnesses remain applicable.
